definitions.short: pasture (the place or the act); also the haunt of wild animals
definitions.full: H4829. mireh מִרְעֶה noun masculine Ezek 34:14 pasturage, pasture ; — absolute ׳מ Gen 47:4 +; construct מִרְעֵה Isa 34:14 ; suffix מִרְעֵהוּ Job 39:8 , מִעֵיכֶם Ezek 34:8 ; — pasturage , לַצּאֹן Gen 47:4 (J), compare 1Chr 4:39 , 41 , also Isa 32:14 ; ׳מ וָטוֺב שָׂמֵן Isaiah 32:40, compare (figurative) Ezek 34:14 (twice in verse); 34:18 a; of cattle Joel 1:18 , stag Lam 1:6 ; = pasture , of wild ass Job 39:8 ; of כְּפִירִים Nahum 2:12 (but read מְעָרָה cave , for מרעה , We Now, || מָעוֺן ); מִרְעֵיכֶם יֶתֶר Ezek 34:18 b (figurative).
